verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment isolated from production data is a fair axis for an observability SaaS platform, but the evidence pack never documents one. Synthetic monitoring (elastic-docs-5), which simulates user journeys against monitored applications, is an adjacent feature: it is not a sandbox where users or agents can test against Elastic without touching production telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
